jobs.title: Head of SEO and AI Visibility
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the opportunity:

 

Help shape how millions of people discover Smallpdf.

 

Search is changing faster than ever. AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google's evolving search experience are fundamentally changing how people discover products online.

 

At Smallpdf, this matters more than almost anywhere else.

 

Every month, more than 60 million people use our products, and Organic Search remains one of our largest acquisition channels. Every improvement we make can impact millions of users and directly influence business growth.

 

We're looking for someone who wants to define what modern Search should look like - not just by improving rankings, but by connecting SEO, product thinking, experimentation and AI Visibility to real commercial outcomes.

 

This isn't a traditional SEO management role. You'll partner directly with our VP of Growth and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data and Marketing to build one of the strongest organic growth engines in Europe.

 

What you'll own:

Shape the future of Search at Smallpdf

  • Develop and evolve our Organic Search strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery experiences.

  • Identify the biggest opportunities across technical SEO, product-led SEO, programmatic SEO, content, international SEO and AI Visibility.

  • Continuously adapt our strategy as Search evolves.

Turn Search into an even stronger growth engine

  • Prioritize initiatives based on business impact rather than SEO metrics alone.

  • Partner with Data to understand how Search contributes to activation, subscriptions, retention and new ARR.

  • Build a culture of experimentation where hypotheses are tested quickly and decisions are driven by evidence.

Build a high-performing SEO operating model

  • Coach and support an experienced SEO team while helping them prioritize the highest-impact work.

  • Create clear planning, prioritization and reporting processes that increase execution speed and transparency.

  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Product and Design to deliver ambitious initiatives.

Lead Smallpdf's AI Visibility strategy

  • Help define how Smallpdf appears across AI-powered search experiences.

  • Experiment with new approaches to increasing visibility, authority and brand presence across LLM-powered discovery platforms.

  • Stay ahead of changes in Search before they become industry best practices.

 

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • You have 5+ years of SEO experience, ideally within a product-led SaaS or another high-scale digital product environment.

  • You've owned SEO strategy end-to-end, balancing technical SEO, content, on-page, off-page and product-led initiatives to drive measurable business impact - not just rankings or traffic.

  • You think commercially. You're comfortable connecting SEO initiatives to customer acquisition, activation, subscriptions, revenue and long-term growth, and use data to prioritize where to invest.

  • You have a strong grasp of modern Search, with experience navigating algorithm updates, evolving ranking systems and adapting your strategy as the search landscape changes.

  • You're technically hands-on and understand topics such as crawling, indexation, internal linking, site architecture, structured data, Core Web Vitals and international SEO.

  • You're analytical and experimental by nature. You enjoy forming hypotheses, testing ideas quickly, measuring outcomes and iterating based on evidence rather than assumptions.

  • You're comfortable with the core SEO toolset, including Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog (or similar), and enjoy partnering with Analytics teams to understand and measure business impact.

  • You're comfortable moving between strategy and execution. One day you're discussing long-term direction with leadership; the next you're diving into a technical issue or reviewing an experiment.

  • You're excited by how AI is reshaping Search. Whether you've already worked on AI Visibility and LLM optimization or you're actively experimenting and learning, you're eager to help define what modern Search looks like.

  • Formal people management experience is welcome, but not essential. We're equally interested in people who've demonstrated leadership through strategic ownership, cross-functional influence and delivering meaningful outcomes.

Bonus points if you've worked with:

  • Product-led Growth (PLG) or freemium business models

  • International SEO across multiple markets and languages

  • Programmatic or product-led SEO at scale

  • High-traffic consumer or B2B SaaS products

  • AI Search, LLM optimization or emerging search technologies

 

Why this role is different:

  • At many companies, SEO is treated as a support function.

  • At Smallpdf, it's one of our biggest growth levers.

  • You'll influence how tens of millions of people discover our products every month, work directly with leadership that deeply understands Search, and have the freedom to challenge existing assumptions, test bold ideas and shape the future of Organic Growth.

  • You'll also join at a unique moment, as Search is undergoing its biggest transformation in more than a decade. We believe the companies that adapt first will define the next generation of product discovery.

 

If that excites you, you'll fit right in. Apply using the link below and upload your CV - in English, as it’s the standard working language at Smallpdf. A PDF format is preferred.

 

Why Smallpdf?

  • For over a decade, we've helped millions of people make document work simple.

  • Today, more than 60 million people use our products every month across web and mobile.

  • We're a remote-first company with teammates across Europe, combining the speed of a startup with the scale of a global product used in nearly every country.

  • We value curiosity, ownership and thoughtful experimentation. We move quickly, make decisions based on evidence, and give people the autonomy to do their best work.

 

What we offer:

🌍 You get to impact the way over 60 million people get work done every month.

🚀 Push boundaries and dare to fail - that’s how we learn!

💻 Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment, and meet your team occasionally to work together and strengthen the team bond.

🏝️ 30 vacation days - yep, you read that right - that you can take whenever you need them.

🧳 Need a long break? We offer sabbatical leave to employees who’ve been with us for over 2 years.

👶 16 weeks parental leave - 100% of your salary - for all new parents

📚 A personal development budget of up to 2000CHF every year, plus days off for courses or training.

🤓 Internal knowledge sharing and external coaching options during your working hours to boost both your hard and soft skills.

👩 💻 Hack days to challenge you and your team, plus build amazing things.

How to Apply

Please apply using the form below and upload your CV - in English, as it’s the standard working language at Smallpdf. A PDF format is preferred.

Compensation philosophy

At Smallpdf, we believe compensation should be fair, transparent and thoughtfully aligned with the value each person brings to our team. Our approach balances several key factors - current market trends, role expectations, seniority, experience, and geographic location - to ensure every offer is both competitive and equitable.

We review our salary ranges regularly to stay in step with the evolving market, and we make decisions based on skills, impact, and responsibility rather than negotiation strength. Our goal is simple: to recognize and reward great work, support long-term growth and create a compensation structure that feels fair, consistent and grounded in integrity.

We want everyone at Smallpdf to feel valued, supported and empowered to do their best work - and our compensation philosophy is designed to reflect exactly that.

Hiring policy

Smallpdf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we believe our strength comes from a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, identities, perspectives, and lived experiences. We welcome applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, abilities, orientations, and life paths. You’ll also have the option to share your pronouns and answer an anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply. This information is completely voluntary, but it helps us stay accountable in building an inclusive and equitable hiring process.

We use AI thoughtfully in our day-to-day work, but we value human curiosity, creativity, and integrity above all. We’re excited to meet candidates who bring genuine expertise, real stories, and authentic experience to the table.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who Are We

Founded in 2013, Smallpdf has been simplifying PDF management for millions globally. We've combined Swiss engineering with a deep understanding of our user's needs, leading us to join forces with Pdftools in 2022. Today, our diverse team of over 100 professionals from 34 nationalities operates across Zurich, Belgrade, and Barcelona. We're committed to making PDF and life just a bit easier for over a billion users in 24 languages.

About the role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer, and a product engineer at heart, you’ll help shape user experiences for millions of people, with real ownership from idea to production. You’ll be an active voice in product and design discussions, contributing not just how we build things, but what we build and why.

We’re not looking for someone who just picks up tickets and writes code - we really want someone who is keen to learn and work in a cross functional environment. You’ll help turn ideas into quick MVPs, run A/B tests or other validation techniques, and use what you learn to guide future decisions. We value pragmatic trade-offs and fast feedback over perfection.

Beyond your product team, you’ll contribute to our Frontend Guild, helping evolve shared standards and practices that keep our frontend codebase healthy, scalable and able to support our future product and experimentation endeavours. Previous experience working on SaaS products with a global audience is highly appreciated, but not a hard requirement.

What you will do

  • Play a major part in delivering complex product features, experiments, or systems, from discovery and planning all the way to rollout and analysis

  • Build fast, reliable, and user-friendly interfaces using modern frontend technologies

  • Create experiments and prototypes to quickly validate assumptions and guide product decisions

  • Look at problems deeply, identify patterns, and propose solutions that are both scalable and maintainable

  • Work closely with Product, Design, and Data to align on goals and deliver meaningful outcomes, even in ambiguous problem spaces

  • Influence product direction through technical insight and user empathy

  • Contribute to how we work as a team, including our engineering standards, rituals, and processes

  • Support teammates, share knowledge, and help maintain a collaborative, open, and inclusive culture

  • Communicate clearly and thoughtfully, explaining decisions, trade-offs, and risks in an approachable way

About you

  • Strong experience building modern web applications at scale

  • Deep knowledge of React and TypeScript, combined with a pragmatic approach to architecture

  • Able to bring clarity to ambiguous situations and move work forward with confidence

  • Comfortable making decisions based on context and data

  • You actively question whether we are solving the right problem, propose alternatives, and help the team course-correct early

  • Passionate about product and motivated by solving real user problems

  • Keen to work closely with Product, Design, and Data to help shape what we build

  • Enjoys iterative work, simplifying scope, and learning through experimentation

  • Strong communicator (in English) who thrives in cross-functional collaboration

  • Humble, open and eager to help others succeed

  • Energized by ownership and motivated to create real impact

  • Based in Zurich or willing to relocate (this is an on-site role, 2-3 days in office min.)

  • Swiss or EU passport holder (or another permit that allows you to work in Switzerland)

Nice to have’s

  • Some comfort and interest in working across the stack (Node.js or simple backend work in Go)

  • Experience writing SQL queries and doing basic analysis, for example checking how a metric behaves across A/B segments to validate an experiment (not running a full experiment analysis with significance calculations etc.)

  • Familiarity with common metrics relevant to SaaS companies, such as MAU, ARR, conversion rates, or churn

What success looks like in this role

  • Regularly ships meaningful product increments and experiments with measurable impact

  • Influences product direction through technical insight and user empathy

  • Improves the frontend codebase beyond the scope of assigned work

  • Is a trusted partner for Product and Design in ambiguous problem spaces

How we work

  • We value curiosity over defensiveness

  • We expect engineers to seek feedback early and often

  • We prefer simple, understandable solutions over clever ones

  • We treat mistakes as learning opportunities, not blame assignments

We use the latest technologies

  • React (with hooks)

  • TypeScript (through Babel)

  • Redux

  • NodeJs

  • styled-components

  • Redshift

  • Backend: Go, Python, AWS, Hetzner, Cloudflare

Check our stack via https://stackshare.io/smallpdf/frontend

Our benefits

🌍 You get to impact how over 30 million people get work done monthly.

🚀 Push boundaries and dare to fail - that’s how we learn!

🏝️ 30 vacation days - yep, you read that right - you can take them whenever you need them.

🕘 Flexibility: we have flexible working hours.

🧳 Need a long break? We offer sabbatical leave to employees who’ve been with us for over two years.

👶 16 weeks parental leave - 100% of your salary - for all new parents.

🐶 Don’t leave your four-legged friends at home; our Zurich office is pet-friendly.

📚 A well-being budget of up to 2,000 CHF every year that can be used for training and development (plus days off for courses or training) and for physical and mental well-being purposes.

👩‍💻 Hack days to challenge you and your team, plus build amazing things.

How to Apply

Please apply using the form below and upload your CV - in English, as it’s the standard working language at Smallpdf. A PDF format is preferred.

Compensation philosophy

At Smallpdf, we believe compensation should be fair, transparent, and thoughtfully aligned with the value each person brings to our team. Our approach balances several key factors - current market trends, role expectations, seniority, experience, and geographic location - to ensure every offer is both competitive and equitable.

We review our salary ranges regularly to stay in step with the evolving market, and we make decisions based on skills, impact, and responsibility rather than negotiation strength. Our goal is simple: to recognize and reward great work, support long-term growth, and create a compensation structure that feels fair, consistent, and grounded in integrity.

We want everyone at Pdftools to feel valued, supported, and empowered to do their best work - and our compensation philosophy is designed to reflect exactly that.

Hiring policy

Smallpdf is an equal-opportunity employer, and we believe our strength comes from a team that reflects a wide range of backgrounds, identities, perspectives, and lived experiences. We welcome applicants of all genders, ethnicities, ages, abilities, orientations, and life paths. You’ll also have the option to share your pronouns and answer an anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply. This information is completely voluntary, but it helps us stay accountable in building an inclusive and equitable hiring process.

We use AI thoughtfully in our day-to-day work, but we value human curiosity, creativity, and integrity above all. We’re excited to meet candidates who bring genuine expertise, real stories, and authentic experience to the table.

By submitting your application, you agree to Smallpdf handling and storing your data in accordance with our privacy guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Atomic Team)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.

As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.

About the role

Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.

As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

  • Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

  • Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

  • Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

  • Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

  • Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

  • Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

  • Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

  • Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

About you

  • 6+ years in product management

  • Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

  • AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

  • Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

  • Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

  • Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

  • Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds

  • You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

  • Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it

  • A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English

Nice to have

  • Document or file-processing products

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn't be complicated. Today, we're an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries.

We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.

As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making, and continuous innovation.


About the role

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help us answer some of the most important questions shaping Smallpdf's growth.

How much value does each marketing channel really generate? What drives users to convert, subscribe, and stay? Where are we missing opportunities to improve our product and business performance?

These questions don't always have straightforward answers, and that's where you come in.

You'll work at the intersection of Data Science, Product and Growth, using advanced analytics, statistical methods, experimentation, and causal inference to uncover what drives our business and what we should do next.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys owning complex problems end to end: from understanding the business challenge and working with raw data to building reliable data models, conducting analyses, and turning findings into actionable recommendations.

You'll join our Data team, reporting to the Head of Data and collaborating closely with our Growth and Product leadership. You'll have the autonomy to challenge assumptions, investigate opportunities, and influence decisions that directly impact our business.

We're not looking for someone who simply reports what happened. We're looking for someone who can explain why it happened, what it means and what we should do about it.


What you'll do

  • Drive business-critical investigations. Own complex analytical questions across the user journey, from acquisition and activation to conversion, monetization, and retention. Identify opportunities and translate your findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Uncover what really drives growth. Analyze marketing channel performance, attribution, and incrementality across SEO, paid search, CRM, and emerging channels. Help our teams understand the true impact of their investments and make smarter decisions.

  • Design and analyze experiments. Partner with Product and Growth teams on A/B testing, experiment design, and statistical evaluation. Apply causal inference and quasi-experimental methods when traditional experimentation isn't possible.

  • Build and own reliable data models. Work hands-on with SQL, Python, and data transformation tools to develop, test, document, and maintain production-ready data models. Take ownership of the data foundations behind your analyses rather than relying on others to prepare them.

  • Turn data into decisions. Go beyond dashboards and descriptive reporting to explain performance drivers, challenge assumptions, and recommend concrete actions that improve business outcomes.

  • Proactively identify opportunities. Investigate unexpected changes in traffic, conversion, and customer behavior. Develop analytical frameworks, predictive models, and data products that help teams identify opportunities and act faster.

  • Partner across the business. Work closely with Product Managers, Growth specialists, engineers, and leadership to translate ambiguous business challenges into structured analytical approaches and measurable outcomes.


What we're looking for

  • Strong experience in applied Data Science or advanced analytics, ideally in a SaaS, product-led growth, digital product, or marketing-driven business, with a track record of influencing real business decisions.

  • Advanced SQL and data modeling skills, including experience designing, building, testing, and maintaining reliable data models. Experience with dbt or similar tools is highly relevant.

  • Strong Python skills, with the ability to perform statistical analyses, develop predictive models, and build practical data products.

  • Solid foundations in statistics, experimentation and causal inference, with experience designing and evaluating A/B tests and applying appropriate analytical methods to complex business questions.

  • Experience in Growth or Marketing Analytics, with an understanding of acquisition channels, conversion funnels, attribution, incrementality, and customer behavior. Experience with SEO or paid search analytics is particularly valuable.

  • Strong product and commercial thinking. You understand how metrics connect to business outcomes and can identify which questions are worth investigating.

  • End-to-end ownership. You're comfortable working across the analytical lifecycle, from raw data and modeling to interpretation, communication, and recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can turn complex analyses into clear, compelling narratives and recommendations that both technical and non-technical stakeholders can act on.

  • Curiosity, initiative and a proactive mindset. You enjoy asking questions, challenging assumptions, and exploring problems beyond the initial request.

What makes you stand out

  • Experience working in a subscription-based or product-led growth business, particularly with conversion, pricing, retention, or customer lifetime value.

  • Hands-on experience with marketing incrementality, attribution modeling, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), or quasi-experimental techniques.

  • Experience building analytical frameworks or data products that have been adopted and used by business teams.

  • Experience working in a small, high-impact data team where you've independently owned both the analytical work and the underlying data models.

  • A demonstrated ability to influence Product, Growth, or Marketing strategy through rigorous analysis and clear recommendations.

Why join Smallpdf?

Work on problems that matter. Your analyses will help shape decisions across a global product used by millions of people, with a direct connection to growth and business performance.

Own your work end to end. You'll have the autonomy to investigate meaningful questions, build solutions, and see your recommendations translate into action.

Collaborate with talented people. Join a highly collaborative team and work directly with experienced Data, Product, and Growth leaders who value curiosity, ownership, and thoughtful decision-making.

Make an impact at scale. Combine the opportunities of a globally established product with the agility and ownership of a lean, ambitious team.

Keep learning and growing. We value people who challenge assumptions, experiment, share knowledge, and continuously improve how we work.

What we offer:

🌍 You get to impact the way over 60 million people get work done every month.

🚀 Push boundaries and dare to fail - that’s how we learn!

💻 Enjoy the flexibility of a remote work environment, and meet your team occasionally to work together and strengthen the team bond.

🏝️ 30 vacation days - yep, you read that right - that you can take whenever you need them.

🧳 Need a long break? We offer sabbatical leave to employees who’ve been with us for over 2 years.

👶 16 weeks parental leave - 100% of your salary - for all new parents

📚 A personal development budget of up to 2000CHF every year, plus days off for courses or training.

🤓 Internal knowledge sharing and external coaching options during your working hours to boost both your hard and soft skills.

👩 💻 Hack days to challenge you and your team, plus build amazing things.

Location & working model

This is a full-time position open to candidates based in eligible European locations. We offer remote work across supported locations, with a hybrid option for team members based in Zurich.

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

How to Apply

Ready to turn complex data into meaningful business impact? We'd love to hear from you.

Please apply using the form below and upload your CV - in English, as it’s the standard working language at Smallpdf. A PDF format is preferred.
